title: Where Does the Sound Go? Tracing Acoustic Information Loss in Audio-Conditioned LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.05871v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio-conditioned language models often underuse acoustic cues such as prosody, emotion, and non-speech sounds, raising the question of whether ASR-supervised frontends discard this information before it reaches the LM. We test whether the frontend is responsible by comparing Whisper-Tiny and Whisper-Small with EnCodec, DAC-VAE, and WavTokenizer in a shared Qwen3.5-4B audio-LM pipeline on ASR, emotion recognition, and sound captioning. Encoder replacement alone does not resolve this underuse: Whisper variants remain strongest overall, including on emotion and environmental sound captioning. To localize the failure, we trace task-relevant information through the encoder, projector, LM layers, and LM head. Linear probes and geometric analyses show that discriminative acoustic structure remains recoverable at the final LM layer, even when MCQA accuracy trails probe accuracy by up to 83 points. translated_title: 声音去哪儿了？追踪音频条件大语言模型中的声学信息损失
translated_abstract: 音频条件语言模型往往未能充分利用声学线索，如韵律、情感和非语音声音，这引发了一个问题：基于ASR监督训练的前端是否在信息到达语言模型之前就丢弃了这些信息。我们通过在共享的Qwen3.5-4B音频-语言模型流水线中，将Whisper-Tiny和Whisper-Small与EnCodec、DAC-VAE和WavTokenizer进行比较，在ASR、情感识别和声音描述任务上检验前端是否是问题根源。结果表明，仅替换编码器并不能解决这种利用不足：Whisper变体在整体上仍然表现最强，包括在情感和环境声音描述任务上。为了定位失败环节，我们追踪了任务相关信息在编码器、投影器、语言模型各层以及语言模型输出头中的传递情况。线性探针和几何分析表明，即使在多选题任务准确率比探针准确率低多达83个百分点的情况下，判别性声学结构在语言模型最后一层仍然可以被恢复。由于答案格式和解码过程……
tldr: 研究发现音频条件大语言模型中声学信息利用不足的问题并非源于ASR前端编码器，声学信息在语言模型最后一层仍可被恢复，说明损失发生在模型输出与解码环节。
en_tdlr: Acoustic information loss in audio-conditioned LLMs is not caused by the ASR-supervised frontend; discriminative acoustic information remains recoverable at the final LM layer, indicating the failure lies in output decoding rather than the encoder.
